section_1_tools.title: Hub: Run 100 Claude Code or Codex sessions concurrently
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: Allows developers to scale up parallel AI coding agent sessions like Claude Code or Codex to handle massive refactoring or testing tasks concurrently across environments.

section_1_tools.title: QA.tech MCP: Verify IDE code changes with automated QA agents
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: Brings automated QA agents directly into your Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflow, letting you test and verify code changes straight from your IDE.

section_2_ai_news.title: OpenAI merges Chat and Work into a shared usage meter
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: OpenAI has started rolling out a unified Chat and Work experience in ChatGPT, combining them under a single usage limit. Heavy users may hit their rate limits sooner, prompting a need to optimize agent workflows and prompts for better efficiency.

section_2_ai_news.title: Amazon and Meta in talks to lift blockade on AI shopping agent Muse
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Amazon and Meta are reportedly discussing a deal to allow Meta's Muse AI agent to connect directly to Amazon's store, potentially opening up major new API and shopping distribution channels for agent developers.

section_2_ai_news.title: Privacy-focused AI startup Maple raises $5.3M for TEE-based agents
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Maple uses trusted execution environments (TEEs) and open-source code so users can run desktop and cloud AI agents without handing over private personal data, a model addressing growing enterprise and developer security concerns.

section_3_india_news.title: MeitY Defends Sarvam's Token Factory Amid Chinese LLM Controversy
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Sarvam's choice to host open-weight foreign models alongside its own 105B model sparked intense debate over sovereign AI. For developers, Token Factory is a major new inference API running on GPUs in India.

section_3_india_news.title: PhonePe Revives IPO Plans for Q1 2027 at $12B–$15B Valuation
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: PhonePe is gearing up for a massive Rs 12,000–14,000 crore public listing. Its return to profitability and rapid credit scaling signal strong market tailwinds for India's fintech ecosystem.

section_3_india_news.title: Vegapay Raises $10M to Scale Credit Line on UPI Infrastructure
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Vegapay powers co-branded credit programmes and UPI credit lines for major banks and fintechs. The fresh capital will expand secured credit infrastructure and developer APIs.

section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: The AI-native customer experience platform is pushing hard into agentic AI and voice-of-customer analytics, scaling operations across the GCC, US, and India.
